values.value: Finds: Active Product2 records with more than 5 SBQQ__BlockPrice__c tier rows. Why it matters: Each block-price tier typically generates a separate downstream item record (e.g. NetSuite regular + renewal records — one SF block-priced product can become 8-20 NS items). Past ~5 tiers, the SF↔NS mapping surface becomes the dominant driver of sync errors, missing external IDs, and accounting-approved-flag mismatches. The proliferation also compounds at every product clone or renewal. Suppress a finding: when the tiered structure is intentional and the customer's billing system handles the downstream items cleanly. Disable the detector: only if your business model genuinely requires >5 tiers per product across the catalog.
